independent_grade.notes: The diff correctly implements post-publish release baseline regression detection and idempotent issue filing. Predecessor selection walks first-parent history (current commit excluded) against the published baselines index, so out-of-order concurrent publishes cannot pick a future baseline; equal totalRuns is fail-closed; the dual threshold (drop > 0.5pp via integer loss arithmetic and >=2 additional losses) matches the boundary fixtures. Issue mutation dedupes on a full-SHA HTML marker across open/closed automation issues, reopens when needed, and reuses runIssueIntake with GITHUB_TOKEN create/update plus PAT assignment. deploy.yml wires detect-after-publish, gates filing on the detector output, keeps tokens step-scoped, and serializes same-SHA sweeps without cancel-in-progress. Coverage exercises detector edges, issue create/update/reopen/failure/guard paths, and workflow structure. Scope stays on the automation path plus required 3-apple artifacts; no gameplay/determinism policy breaks.
